title: University of California Santa Cruz PRA Databases

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1 — any databases and/or spreadsheets used to track requests under the California Public Records Act from April 1, 2025 to the date of this request's fulfillment.
2 — any and all policy documents, manuals, memos and/or reports regarding the processing of public records requests from April 1, 2025 to the date of this request's fulfillment.

In the regard to the database requested in paragraph 1, please provide the database in its original electronic format pursuant to Cal. Gov. Code § 6253.9.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Ed Burton

title: Records related to Israel Institute Teaching Fellows, 2024-present

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1- all email correspondence to/from the Director of the UCLA Younes & Soraya Nazarian Center for Israel Studies email address containing the keywords "Israel Institute," or discussing the placement of a Israel Institute Teaching Fellows to offer courses at UCLA, from January 1, 2024 to the date of this request's fulfillment;

2- all email correspondence to/from the Director of the UCLA Center for Middle East Development email address containing the keywords "Israel Institute," or discussing the placement of a Israel Institute Teaching Fellows to offer courses at UCLA, from January 1, 2024 to the date of this request's fulfillment;

3- all gift agreements between the Israel Institute and UCLA, from January 1, 2024 to the date of this request's fulfillment.

4- any offer letters, position descriptions, and hiring paperwork regarding the placement of Israel Institute teaching fellows at UCLA, from January 1, 2024 to the date of this request's fulfillment.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Ed Burton
